cases.name: Cindy Marie Nelson Blackwell
cases.about: Her obituary said, "After Cindy graduated from Foley High School, she went on to do what she loved the most. Raising her three children, adventuring any chance she had, and working as a waitress where she acquired a huge work family who she loved dearly. Cindy was full of life and always knew how to make light out of any situation. She will be remembered as the loving, kind-hearted, generous woman she is."
